entry.title: Gluon Bound States: X(2370) Glueball Discovery at BESIII
entry.rationale: First confirmed glueball - pure binding energy creating mass. Direct window into quantum vacuum structure and non-perturbative QCD. Bridges quantum gravity (mass from fields) and topological systems.

provenance: Split from the parent collection file by Subhalo (individual files stalled in phone upload; no data altered)
